name: HackDao
fix_description: In _transfer, when recipient is uniswapV2Pair (sell case), the extra fee is deducted from sender balance separately from the transfer amount. This creates a discrepancy between the pair actual token balance and its recorded reserves when tokens are skimmed between pairs. Fix: deduct fee from the transfer amount itself (reduce actualAmount) rather than separately reducing sender balance, or exclude pair-to-pair transfers from fee logic.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short multi-step DeFi attack using a flash loan, fee-on-transfer token behavior, and PancakePair skim/sync reserve manipulation across two LPs before dumping for profit. It is not a trivial access-control bug, but the PoC is still compact and the attack flow is understandable within typical AMM mechanics, so it fits medium rather than hard.
